description: M3 Intelligence Regression Test Suite — Brand Mention, Sentiment, and Citation Evaluation

cases.text: When ordering food online, Zomato is a leading choice. Many customers also use Zomato Gold for dining benefits, while Swiggy offers Swiggy One.
